prompt_text: Write a C solution for the HackerRank problem Triplets.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution counts index-based increasing triplets instead of distinct value-based triplets required by the problem.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Fails to eliminate duplicate values and does not enforce uniqueness of triplet values.

test_failures.details: Overcounts triplets due to duplicate elements

improvement_strategy.improved_prompt: Ensure counting of distinct value-based triplets rather than index-based combinations.
improvement_strategy.improvements_made: Use sorting + unique compression + prefix/suffix counts
